name: GitHub
description: 在侧栏查看、回复、关闭和重开当前项目的 GitHub issue 与 PR，也可查看 Actions 运行、失败原因与日志，并重跑或取消。会话里的 agent 也能调用。支持设备码登录，已登录的 gh CLI 可直接复用。

configuration.title: Personal Access Token（可选）
configuration.description: 不想用设备码登录时填写；需要 Issues、Pull requests 与 Actions 读写权限

agentTools.name: github_list
agentTools.description: List GitHub issues or pull requests of a repository (defaults to the current project's origin). Returns number, title, state, author, labels, url.

repo.description: owner/name; omit to use the current project's GitHub origin

agentTools.name: github_view
agentTools.description: View one GitHub issue or pull request with its body and comments.

repo.description: owner/name; omit to use the current project's GitHub origin

agentTools.name: github_comment
agentTools.description: Post a comment (Markdown) on a GitHub issue or pull request.

repo.description: owner/name; omit to use the current project's GitHub origin

agentTools.name: github_set_state
agentTools.description: Close or reopen a GitHub issue or pull request, optionally posting a comment first.

repo.description: owner/name; omit to use the current project's GitHub origin

reason.description: Issue close reason; ignored for PRs

comment.description: Optional comment posted before changing state

agentTools.name: github_runs
agentTools.description: List recent GitHub Actions workflow runs of a repository (defaults to the current project's origin). Returns id, name, title, number, status, conclusion, branch, and url.

repo.description: owner/name; omit to use the current project's GitHub origin

agentTools.name: github_run
agentTools.description: Get one Actions run with its jobs, steps, and annotations for failed jobs. Use github_job_log to read a job log.

repo.description: owner/name; omit to use the current project's GitHub origin

agentTools.name: github_job_log
agentTools.description: Read an Actions job log via the gh CLI. Returns lines around ##[error] when present, otherwise the last lines (default 150).

repo.description: owner/name; omit to use the current project's GitHub origin

lines.description: Tail length when the log has no ##[error] line. Default 150, max 1000

agentTools.name: github_run_action
agentTools.description: Rerun, rerun failed jobs, or cancel a GitHub Actions workflow run.

repo.description: owner/name; omit to use the current project's GitHub origin
